derivedFrom.note: Every threshold is the score at a given percentile of that scenario's KovaaK's leaderboard. The percentiles are ours; the scores are a fact about the game. No other benchmark's numbers appear in this file - where one is consulted it is converted to percentiles and discarded (tools/calibrateLadder.ts). Season 2 re-cuts these against Apogee's own population, including where one window hands over to the next.
